stop: Stop when all 18 reference shards (cal 20k, test 20k, H3/H4/H6/H7 5k each, per plate state) have sidecars with matching sha256, or at the owner cap.
_doc: Stage B reference splits (docs/board/generator.md, Proposal). One runner unit = one generator shard; data land at OUT/gen/<plate>/<split>/shard_<k>.npz with rho_ref_<plate>.json. Episode identity is fixed by (plate, split, index): re-running a shard reproduces it, so a lost box just requeues. unit_s is steady-state estimate; overhead_s covers torch.compile warm-up (~40 s local) and imports.

groups.purpose: Persist the fixed plated cal reference split (schema cfcap.gen/v2 with rho_dec) for conformal calibration, test and held-out evaluation; training data are generated on the fly from the same deterministic generator.
